text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with
Narita
Brian...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Nothing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Mmm... nothing here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. No problem. Don't worry about
it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан stays fidgety all the way
back to the
academy. I probably ought
to ask a little more
seriously.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Oh, fine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: If something happened, please tell me.

text_block_list.text: Tch... You don't quit, do you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I lost my wallet. That's all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
There was nothing important in it, just
some small
change, so it doesn't matter.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...What's with you all of sudden?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I don't want you to make a habit of giving up.

text_block_list.text: Tch. How very thoughtful of you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up. I'm going to look for it
later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: It'll be easier if we both look for it.

text_block_list.text: Siiiigh... This is exactly why I didn't want you to find out.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I lost it. I'll find it. You just go home.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'm sure we'll find it in no time!

When you're in trouble, you should ask for help.
Let's ask someone.

text_block_list.text:
Where does all that optimism come
from?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Eh, whatever. I'm guessing you have
some kind of
plan, since you're so
optimistic. So, where should
we start
looking?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: That's way too inefficient...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
But I guess we'll never find it if we don't
go back.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Fine. We'll go as far as we have to.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We retrace our steps until we arrive back
at the
station.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Oh. That's right! I took out my wallet
when I
bought my ticket...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It was in the lost and found. Looks like I
left it
next to the ticket machine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Yeah... So...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for the help.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Who on earth are we gonna to ask? You
want to
go around asking people on the
street?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
No way. That's a terrible idea. Are you
an idiot or
something?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be better to ask at the
police box or
in the nearby stores?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: H-hey, wait!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Brian decides to go back to the station
to ask
about her wallet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh yes, we've got it here. It looks like it
was
found near the ticket machine.
text_block_list.name: Station Staff

text_block_list.text:
And so, Нарита Брайан's lost wallet is
returned to
her safe and sound.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Still, I'm surprised we found it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: It's because you didn't give up.

text_block_list.text:
Tch! Don't get carried away. This is just
thanks to
some stranger who picked it
up for me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Well, that was one of the reasons I was
able to
find it, anyway...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Enough of that, it's getting late. Let's
hurry back.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
With her wallet found, Нарита Брайан and I
head
back to the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With her wallet now safe and sound,
Нарита Брайан
and I head back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
